scenario.summary: Adversaries are weaponizing trust across the enterprise stack by abusing legitimate tools like ScreenConnect, AI coding assistants, and Microsoft first-party clients. Intrusions leverage AiTM phishing to bypass MFA and deploy signed payloads via DLL sideloading, often achieving full compromise from infection to cloud login in just eight minutes.

hunt.name: Abuse of Trusted RMM and AI Agent Software
hunt.description: This hunt examines the weaponization of legitimate, signed software in the enterprise stack. It follows a phased flow: first identifying hosts with ScreenConnect or AI assistants, then searching for rapid MSI sideloading and suspicious RMM child processes. Finally, it correlates this with high-frequency automated actions and protocol tunneling to distinguish between administrative use and adversary abuse.

nodes.label: Identify hosts with RMM or AI software

config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{ai_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find the subset of the estate where trusted software (RMM or AI) has actually run in the window to scope the hunt.
config.expected_signal: A list of hostnames. Silence means no such software is active in the environment.

primitive_config.label: Identify hosts with RMM or AI software
primitive_config.content: SELECT DISTINCT device_hostname FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (instr(',' || '{{ai_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')

nodes.label: MSIexec loading modules from user-writable paths

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, module_path, time FROM hb_module_activity WHERE LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%msiexec.exe' AND (LOWER(module_path) LIKE '%\users\public\%' OR LOWER(module_path) LIKE '%\appdata\%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify potential DLL sideloading matching the report's MSI-delivery pattern.
config.expected_signal: MSIexec loading a module from a user profile is the core observable for the 16-second attack window described in the report.

nodes.label: Shell spawns from trusted RMM tools

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, parent_process_name, process_name, process_cmd_line, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{rmm_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(parent_process_name) || ',') > 0 AND instr(',' || '{{shell_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify when an attacker or technician spawns a shell from an RMM tool.
config.expected_signal: A shell spawned by RMM indicates a technician (or attacker) is running commands; this provides the persistence context.

config.objective: Identify hosts where signed software is performing unexpected execution or spawning shells.
config.description: Summarize whether the observed module loads or RMM shells indicate suspicious initial behavior.
config.expected_signal: A verdict on which hosts show anomalous trust abuse.
config.success_criteria: A list of hosts with suspicious early-stage activity.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) as action_count, MIN(time) as first_action, MAX(time) as last_action FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{ai_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING action_count > 1000
config.description: Detect the 17,600-action pattern by counting unique commands from AI processes with a high threshold.
config.expected_signal: High counts (e.g., >1000 commands) suggest automated abuse of an AI coding agent rather than normal developer work.

primitive_config.label: High-velocity AI assistant command activity
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, COUNT(*) as action_count, MIN(time) as first_action, MAX(time) as last_action FROM hb_process_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{ai_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, process_name HAVING action_count > 1000
primitive_config.expected: High counts (e.g., >1000 commands) suggest automated abuse of an AI coding agent rather than normal developer work.

config.content: SELECT dst_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE (instr(',' || '{{ai_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dst_endpoint_ip HAVING host_count <= 2
config.description: Identify protocol tunneling by finding rare outbound destinations from RMM or AI tools.
config.expected_signal: Outbound traffic to rare IP addresses from trusted apps is an indicator of C2 tunneling.

primitive_config.label: Outbound tunneling from trusted processes
primitive_config.content: SELECT dst_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) as host_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE (instr(',' || '{{ai_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0 OR instr(',' || '{{rmm_process_names}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(process_name) || ',') > 0) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY dst_endpoint_ip HAVING host_count <= 2
